description: Build and test harness. htdocs/luci-static/resources is generated from src/resource by scripts/build-js.mjs -- never edit it by hand. Pins the @eamonxg/luci-theme-tokens version for Renovate/Dependabot, but scripts/sync-tokens.mjs vendors from the ShiranekoWrt fork checkout (../luci-theme-tokens, branding branch) FIRST -- the npm package lacks our shiranekowrt preset + setguard operator.
